items.title: 2. Chemical Pollutants (Heavy Metals and Pesticides) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 2. Chemical Pollutants (Heavy Metals and Pesticides): a main subheading of 33.3 Common Water Pollutants, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 250-250.

blocks.text: Is pollution mein aksar zehreeli heavy metals hoti hain, jaise mercury, lead, arsenic aur cadmium, aur kheti ke chemicals jaise pesticides aur herbicides. Heavy metals industrial discharge (factories ka ganda pani), mining (kaan-kani) aur improper waste disposal (kachra ghalat tareeqe se phenkna) se pani mein aati hain. Kuch heavy metals ke sources neeche hain.

blocks.alt: Aag par rakha pani ka bartan, oopar Boiling Water (100 °C) likha hai aur bhaap uth rahi hai. Pani mein bacteria, virus aur narangi toote hue tukre hain. Pani ki satah se lakeer Intact Bacteria/Virus (sabit jarasim) tak, aur aag se lakeer Broken Microbe Structure (toote hue jarasim) tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Ubalne se zyada tar bacteria, viruses aur protozoa mar jate aur pani peene ke qabil hota hai, magar doosre pollutants sirf ubalne se door nahi hote (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 100 °C par garmi jaraseem ka structure (banawat) tor deti hai: oopar 'Intact' sabit jarasim hain, neeche 'Broken' toote hue. Lekin heavy metals, nitrates ya pesticides ubalne se khatam nahi hote, balke pani bhaap bane to un ka concentration thora barh jata hai.

items: Mercury zyada tar koyla jalane (coal combustion), sone ki kaan-kani aur thermometer ya battery banane wali factories ke waste se pani mein aati hai. Aquatic sediments (pani ki tah ki mitti) mein bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) mein badal dete hain, jo zyada khatarnak hai.

Lead ke bare sources: leaded petrol (ab poori duniya mein band), purane lead ke pipes (plumbing), lead-acid batteries aur paints. Lead ions (Pb²⁺) aksar pipes ke zang lagne (corrosion) se pani mein aate hain.

Metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate fertilizer ki impurities (milawat) pani mein cadmium ke bare sources hain. Yeh chemicals non-biodegradable (qudrati taur par khatam na hone wale) hain aur food chain mein jama ho kar aquatic life (pani ke jaandaron) aur insanon dono ke liye long-term (lambe arse ka) khatra bante hain.

blocks.text: Health effects of Heavy Metals (heavy metals ke sehat par asraat)

Heavy metals ke atomic weights aur densities zyada hote hain. Yeh non-biodegradable hain (khud nahi galti), is liye jandaron ke tissues mein jama hoti jati hain aur khaas taur par khatarnak hain. Kuch aam heavy metals aur un ke nuqsanat:

items: Methyl mercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) fat (charbi) mein bohat ghulti hai, is liye aasani se biological membranes (cell ki jhilliyan) paar kar leti hai aur biomagnification karti hai (food chain mein oopar jate hue barhti hai). Yeh potent (taqatwar) neurotoxin (nervous system ka zehr) hai jo blood-brain barrier bhi paar kar leta hai. Lambe arse tak is ka samna Minamata disease laata hai: ataxia (chalne mein balance bigarna), hathon pairon ka sun hona (numbness) aur general muscle weakness (aam patthon ki kamzori).

Lead haemoglobin banne mein rukawat dalta hai, jis se anaemia (khoon ki kami) hoti hai. Bachon mein yeh cumulative (jama hota rehne wala) poison hai jo irreversible neurological damage (dimagh aur nervous system ko aisa nuqsan jo theek nahi hota) deta hai, aur un ki development (nashonuma) der se hoti hai.

Cadmium (Cd) lambe arse tak jism mein jaye to “Itai-itai” bimari hoti hai: cadmium haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le leta hai aur haddiyan bohat brittle (bhurbhuri) ho jati hain. Is se kidneys (gurdon) ko bhi sakht nuqsan (nephrotoxicity) hota hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf bara halka neela gola Ca2+, beech mein daen taraf teer jis par Ionic Displacement Potential likha hai, aur daen taraf chhota gehra neela gola Cd2+.
blocks.caption: Cd2+ ki charge density zyada hai, is liye yeh haddiyon mein Ca2+ ki jagah le leta hai (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono ions ka charge 2+ hai. Cd2+ (taqreeban 95 pm) Ca2+ (taqreeban 100 pm) se thora chhota hai, is liye us ki charge density thori zyada hai aur woh haddi mein calcium ki jagahon par baith jata hai. Kitab ki drawing mein size ka farq bara dikhaya gaya hai; asal mein dono ions qareeb qareeb barabar hain, isi liye Cd2+ itni aasani se fit hota hai.
Kuch heavy metals ki limiting concentrations (zyada se zyada ijazat wali miqdar, mg/L) Table 33.2 mein di gayi hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Minamata Disaster 1950 ki dahai mein Minamata, Japan mein industrial pollution ka ek bohat bura (severe) waqia tha. Pani mein methylmercury chhori gayi, jis se bohat logon ko mercury ka zehr (mercury poisoning) hua: hazaron log neurological damage (dimagh aur nervous system ke nuqsan) ka shikar hue, birth defects (bachay naqais paida hona) aur deaths (mautein) huin, aur environmental devastation (mahol ki tabahi) hui.

blocks.alt: Minamata bimari (mercury ke zehr) se mutasir aik mareez ki surmai (greyscale) drawing: baitha hua, sahare ke saath, haath murre hue; chehre ki tafseel nahi.
blocks.caption: Aisi neurological bimari (dimagh aur nervous system ki bimari) ke shikar aik mareez ki tasveer (Did You Know box ki photo ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: b) Pesticides and Herbicides (keere aur jari-bootiyan maarne wale chemicals)

DDT aur Glyphosate jaise pesticides aur herbicides ek aur hazardous (khatarnak) cheez hain jo pani ko ganda karte aur insan ki sehat ke sangeen masail paida karte hain. In ke bare sources kheton ka behta pani (agricultural runoff) aur domestic gardening (gharon ki baghbani) hain. DDT non-polar hai aur pani mein taqreeban nahi ghulta, lekin machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues mein bohat ghulta hai. DDT jaise bohat se purane pesticides persistent organic pollutants (POPs) hain, yani der tak khatam na hone wale organic pollutants. Pesticides hormonal disruption (hormones ka bigarna) aur developmental problems (barhne ke masail) se jure hain. Chemical pollution pani ki quality bhi girati hai, biodiversity (jaandaron ki qismon ki tadaad) kam karti hai aur aquatic ecosystems ko bigarti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab DDT aur Glyphosate dono ko “non-polar aur pani mein na ghulne wale” kehti hai. Yeh DDT par sahi hai, lekin glyphosate polar hai aur pani mein bohat ghulta hai. (33.1 mein bhi kitab kehti hai ke polar pesticides pani mein ghul kar water cycle mein jate hain.)

Bohat se pesticides endocrine disruptors hain: yeh qudrati hormones, jaise estrogen, ki tarah kaam karte hain. Is se wildlife (jangli jaandaron) mein reproductive failure (bachay paida karne ki nakami) hoti hai (misal: parindon ke ande ka chhilka patla ho jana), aur insanon mein hormones se jure cancers se in ka talluq hai. Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) bijli ke transformers mein coolant (thanda karne wala) ke taur par use hote rahe hain; yeh khatarnak waste ki jagahon se pani mein riste hain. PCBs ko “probable human carcinogens” (shayad insan mein cancer karne wale) mana jata hai. Yeh immune system (jism ka bimari se larne wala system) ko suppress (kamzor) karte hain aur skin conditions (jild ki bimariyan), jaise chloracne, paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “Polychlorinated biphenols” likhti hai. Sahi naam polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) hai: yeh biphenyl (C₁₂H₁₀) ke chlorine wale derivatives hain. Biphenols compounds ki alag class hai.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ke aaza (organs), ran ka patha, tang ki haddi aur baazu ki khoon ki naliyan. Oopar baen spray karta shakhs (Pesticides), daen Cd, Pb, Cu, Zn ke saath Heavy Metals; dono se teer jism ki taraf. Labels: Alzheimer (dimagh); baen: Cardiac Failure, Lung Cancer, Hepatic Necrosis, Ovarian Cancer, Musculoskeletal Diseases; daen: Reducing Thyroid Hormone, Intravascular Hemolysis, Vomiting/Diarrhea, Renal Dysfunction, Osteoporosis.
blocks.caption: Figure 33.2: Heavy metals aur pesticides ke insani jism par asraat (kitab ki Figure 33.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har label ki lakeer us organ (uzw) se nikalti hai jise nuqsan hota hai: dil (cardiac failure), phephre (lung cancer), jigar (hepatic necrosis), thyroid (hormone kam), khoon (haemolysis), maida (ulti ya dast), gurde (renal dysfunction), haddi (osteoporosis).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 33.2 mein Pesticides aur jism ke darmiyan teer dono taraf nok wala (double-headed) chhapa hai. Zehr sirf jism mein jata hai, is liye yahan Heavy Metals ki tarah ek taraf ka teer banaya gaya hai.
